title: Account Slicing Scorecard + Runbook (QBR)
content:
Purpose:
A compact, actionable account-slicing scorecard and runbook to prioritize QBR coverage and renewal outreach. Designed for CS managers and AEs preparing 90/60/30 day renewal queues.

When to use:
- Weekly renewal triage (CS Ops exports)
- QBR prep for accounts in the 90→60 day band
- Renewal play allocation across regions and deployment modes

How this sheet is structured (columns expected in export):
- Account Name | ACV / MRR | ARR ARR Bracket (S/M/L) | Primary ICP Fit (Core / Adjacent / Not-target) | Deployment Mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) | Region | Last QBR date | CS Owner | Support Signal (low/med/high) | Latency/Ramp Issues (Y/N) | Usage Trend (↑/→/↓) | Risk Flags (yes/no) | Renewal Date | Score (0-100) | Priority Bucket | Recommended Play | Next Action Owner | Next Action Due

Scoring rubric (weights):
- Revenue weight: 30% (MRR normalized percentile)
- ICP fit: 25% (Core=100, Adjacent=60, Not-target=20)
- Deployment complexity: 20% (Private=80, Dedicated=60, Hosted=30)
- Support/health signals: 15% (low=100, med=60, high-risk=20)
- Region strategic weight: 10% (NA/EU/APAC per product goals)

Score calculation (sheet formula notes):
- Normalize each numeric column to a 0-100 scale, multiply by weight, sum → round to nearest int.
- Example: SCORE = ROUND((MRR_pct*0.30)+(ICP_pts*0.25)+(Deploy_pts*0.20)+(Health_pts*0.15)+(Region_pts*0.10),0)

Priority buckets (derived from score):
- Priority A (85-100): Mandatory QBR + exec outreach. Prep: tailored roadmap, success metrics, renewal negotiation plan.
- Priority B (65-84): QBR recommended, AE+CS joint touch. Prep: value recap, expansion signals.
- Priority C (45-64): Health-check call, automation where possible.
- Priority D (<45): Monitor + automated nurture, low-touch renewals.

Recommended plays by bucket and deployment mode (quick mapping):
- A / Private: Schedule exec QBR, bring infra lead, present on-prem roadmap & compliance checklist, open legal early.
- A / Dedicated: Capacity / SLA review, propose annual reserved commit, propose upgrade path.
- A / Hosted: Highlight cost/latency KPIs, propose usage-based tiering + cost-optimization plan.
- B / any: Joint AE+CS call, case studies for ICP, 60-day success plan, health check automation.
- C / Hosted/Dedicated: Automated pre-QBR pack + 30-min check-in.
- D: Trigger renewal drip, monitor usage signals, flag if support tickets spike.

Meeting agenda (QBR pack contents):
1) Quick wins since last QBR (3 bullets)
2) Usage and cost trends (1 slide/table)
3) Health & support summary (open tickets, latencies)
4) Roadmap alignment / upcoming features likely to matter
5) Renewal timing and options (anchors for negotiation)
6) Action items & owners (clear next steps)

Pre-read checklist (send at least 3 business days before QBR):
- Consolidated metric snapshot (tokens/day, avg latency p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens)
- Open support tickets with SLA, recent logs or error summaries
- Proposed renewal options and justification note
- Exec one-pager: state, ask, desired outcomes

Post-QBR runbook (immediate actions):
- Within 24h: Create Jira ticket JIRA-CS-<acct>-QBR-ACT with: summary, owner, due date, acceptance criteria.
- Within 3 days: AE + legal sync if price/term changes expected.
- Within 7 days: Send recap and updated renewal option worksheet.

Jira ticket template (copy into JIRA create):
- Summary: QBR recap & renewal action - <Account>
- Description: 1) Key outcomes (bullets) 2) Renewal target & options 3) Risks/blocks 4) Attach QBR deck and scorecard export
- Priority: Blocker / High / Medium (map from Priority bucket)

Examples (fabricated rows for clarity):
- AcmeRetail | $18k MRR | Large | Core | Dedicated | NA | 2025-10-12 | CS: Maya T | Support low | N | ↑ | No | 2026-04-15 | SCORE 88 | A | Exec QBR + reserved commit | AE: Jordan | 2026-03-01
- DataFjord | $2.5k MRR | Small | Adjacent | Hosted | EU | 2025-08-09 | CS: Ethan L | Support med | Y | ↓ | Yes | 2026-05-11 | SCORE 52 | C | Health check + automated nurture | CS: Ethan | 2026-03-10

Triage heuristics (fast checks for ops):
- If MRR percentile >= 90 and score > 70 → escalate to CS manager and schedule exec QBR window.
- If support tickets > 5 in last 30d or any P0 → mark high-risk regardless of revenue and set Priority A/B per mitigation plan.
- If deployment = Private and renewal within 90d → legal loop-in required early (30d buffer).

Data export automation notes (ops):
- Source columns: billing (MRR), product usage (tokens/day), support (ticket counts + sev), infra alerts (p95 latency), last QBR date.
- Cron export: csops/exports/renewal_queue.csv - run Mon 0600 PST.
- Sheet formulas: use QUERY to pull last 90 days of usage, VLOOKUP for account metadata, and a helper sheet to normalize percentiles.

Reporting KPIs for leadership during renewal season:
- % of Priority A accounts with scheduled QBR within 14 days
- Renewal conversion rate by bucket (A/B/C/D)
- Time to close post-QBR (median days)
- Dollar at risk (sum MRR in Priority A/B flagged as risk)

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Revisit region weight for 2026 APAC expansion (should APAC weight be +5?).
- Add boolean column for ‘signed-security-addendum’ to better score Private deployments.
- Build a Google Sheets script to auto-create JIRA tickets from Priority A rows. (Maya to prototype)

Collaborator notes (quick):
- Ethan: add mapping of support severities to health points (draft completed 2026-02-20).
- Priya: prototype automated pre-read pack generator (PPT template).
- Maya: owner for exec outreach template and email copy.

Version history snippet:
- v0.1 (2025-11-06) initial draft
- v0.2 (2026-01-11) added scoring weights and example rows
- v0.3 (2026-02-28) included Jira template and automation notes

Notes to reviewer: this is meant to be a practical sheet + step-by-step runbook — keep it slim, the canonical formulas are in the hidden 'helpers' tab of the sheet export. Feedback: prefer numeric weight changes or additional play types for security/compliance-heavy accounts?

(End of doc)
